: 519
code: EE2101
name: CIRCUIT ANALYSIS
academic_units: 3
exam_schedule: 2024-12-0209:00-11:00
common_information: LEC/STUDIO^EELE^THU^1730-1820^LKC-LT^Teaching Wk4,6,8,10,12,13
description: This course focuses on the fundamental principles of circuit theorems and circuit elements, DC/AC and three-phase circuits, transient and steady-state responses, circuit analysis using Laplace transforms.

In this course, you will learn various techniques ('tools') to analyze the operation of real circuits. Our major concern is the analysis of circuits, i.e. the study of the behavior of the circuit, not the creation of circuits, i.e., the engineering design of the circuit.
